water_floor.source: ENC S-57 SOUNDG + DEPCNT (VALDCO 0/2/5/10/20/30/50 m) + COALNE 0 m, constrained TIN sampled onto this 1025² grid; cells CN436122/CN436123/CN436134
water_floor.vertical_datum: ENC DSPM_VDAT=3 = mean sea level (DSPM_DUNI=1 metres) vs GLO-30 EGM2008; the display zero plane treats the two as equal without a measured offset
water_floor.coverage: sea cells beyond the ENC triangulation hold the nearest ENC edge value; no GEBCO outer tail in this bake
water_floor.quality: chart-generalised display interpolation (ZOC B: depth ±1 m + 2%, horizontal ±50 m); never navigation depth

depth_grid.value: positive-down water depth in metres, uint16 flipped like heights.bytes; land and drying cells are 0

shore_foam.note: open-sea COALNE chunks near the static camera presets only; quiet harbour/bay water intentionally unplaced; foam look unverified
